title: Global Markets Shake as Anthropic IPO Meets Tech Sell-Off
subtitle: After a historic market debut, the AI sector faces a difficult reality check

summary.en: Anthropic recently completed the largest initial public offering in history, bringing significant attention to the artificial intelligence sector. However, the company's entry into the stock market was quickly followed by a sharp decline in technology stocks worldwide. Investors are now questioning whether the high costs of building AI infrastructure can be justified by future profits. Major markets in Asia, Europe, and the United States have all experienced significant losses. Experts suggest that the excitement surrounding AI is cooling as market participants demand more evidence of long-term financial stability.
summary.zh: Anthropic 近期完成了史上規模最大的首次公開募股，使人工智慧產業備受矚目。然而，該公司進入股市後，全球科技股隨即出現劇烈跌勢。投資人目前正質疑建設人工智慧基礎設施的高昂成本，是否能由未來的獲利來證明其合理性。亞洲、歐洲與美國的主要市場皆經歷了顯著虧損。專家認為，隨著市場參與者要求更多長期財務穩定的證據，圍繞在人工智慧周邊的熱潮正在冷卻。

paragraphs.en: The excitement surrounding the artificial intelligence industry has hit a major speed bump this week. Anthropic, the company behind the AI tool Claude, recently held its initial public offering (IPO) — the process where a private company first sells shares to the public on a stock exchange. While the event was initially seen as a success, the days that followed brought a wave of selling that has shaken global financial markets.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧產業的熱潮在本週遭遇了重大阻礙。開發人工智慧工具 Claude 的公司 Anthropic 近期完成了首次公開募股（IPO），也就是私人企業首次在證券交易所向大眾出售股份的過程。儘管該事件最初被視為一項成功，但隨後幾天出現的拋售潮已震撼了全球金融市場。

paragraphs.en: According to NPR, Anthropic’s executives rang the opening bell at the Nasdaq stock exchange on Thursday, marking the first time a company focused entirely on AI has gone public. The company reached a valuation of $2 trillion, a sign of the massive interest in AI technology. However, the debut also attracted protesters in San Francisco and New York. These activists and researchers expressed concerns about the speed of AI development, calling on the company to prioritize safety over rapid growth. Before the trading began, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei stated that the company remains committed to keeping its technology under human control, despite the pressures of the business world.
paragraphs.zh: 根據美國公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，Anthropic 的高層於週四在納斯達克（Nasdaq）證券交易所敲響開盤鐘，標誌著一家完全專注於人工智慧的公司首次上市。該公司的估值達到兩兆美元，顯示出市場對人工智慧技術的巨大興趣。然而，這次上市也引來了舊金山與紐約的抗議者。這些行動人士與研究人員表達了對人工智慧發展速度的擔憂，呼籲該公司將安全性置於快速成長之上。在交易開始前，Anthropic 執行長達里奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）表示，儘管面臨商業世界的壓力，公司仍致力於將技術控制在人類手中。

paragraphs.en: Despite the initial excitement, the market mood changed quickly. By Friday, shares in Anthropic had fallen by 9%, losing much of the value gained during its first day. This drop was not isolated. The Guardian reports that the wider technology sector experienced a major "sell-off," a situation where many investors sell their shares at the same time, causing prices to fall. The Nasdaq Composite index, which tracks many tech companies, erased all of its gains for the year 2026. Other major indexes, such as the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average, also saw significant losses, with some entering "correction" territory — a term used when a market index falls by 10% or more from its recent high point.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管最初充滿興奮，市場情緒卻迅速轉變。到了週五，Anthropic 的股價下跌了 9%，損失了上市首日獲得的大部分價值。這種跌勢並非單一事件。衛報（The Guardian）報導指出，更廣泛的科技產業經歷了大規模的「拋售」，即許多投資人同時賣出持股，導致價格下跌。追蹤許多科技公司的納斯達克綜合指數，抹去了 2026 年全年的漲幅。其他主要指數，如標準普爾 500 指數（S&P 500）與道瓊工業平均指數（Dow Jones Industrial Average）也出現顯著虧損，部分甚至進入了「修正」領域，這是指市場指數從近期高點下跌 10% 或以上的術語。

paragraphs.en: This decline was felt far beyond the United States. According to The Guardian, Asian stock markets recorded their worst week since 2020. In Taiwan, stocks dropped 6.7%, leading the local stock exchange to promise investors that they would work to keep the markets stable. Japan and South Korea also saw their major indexes fall by more than 5%. European markets were not spared either, with the Stoxx 600 index posting its biggest weekly loss since March 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 這波跌勢的影響遠超美國。根據衛報報導，亞洲股市創下 2020 年以來最糟糕的一週。在台灣，股市下跌了 6.7%，促使當地證券交易所向投資人承諾將致力於維持市場穩定。日本與南韓的主要指數也下跌超過 5%。歐洲市場也未能倖免，斯托克 600 指數（Stoxx 600）創下自 2025 年 3 月以來的最大單週跌幅。

paragraphs.en: Market analysts believe that Anthropic’s arrival may have contributed to this instability. Chris Beauchamp, an analyst at the trading platform IG, suggested that Anthropic could be "draining market liquidity." This means that investors might be selling their shares in other successful tech companies to raise the cash needed to buy into the new Anthropic stock. As investors move their money around, other companies are feeling the pressure. Companies like Nvidia, Micron, and Advanced Micro Devices saw their stock prices tumble as the market began to doubt the strength of the current AI boom.
paragraphs.zh: 市場分析師認為，Anthropic 的上市可能加劇了這種不穩定性。交易平台 IG 的分析師克里斯·比徹姆（Chris Beauchamp）指出，Anthropic 可能正在「抽乾市場流動性」。這意味著投資人可能為了籌集購買 Anthropic 新股所需的現金，而賣出了其他成功科技公司的股票。隨著投資人調動資金，其他公司也感受到了壓力。像是輝達（Nvidia）、美光（Micron）與超微半導體（Advanced Micro Devices）等公司的股價紛紛重挫，市場開始懷疑當前人工智慧熱潮的強度。

paragraphs.en: NPR reports that the recent market slide is partly driven by a growing fear that the billions of dollars being spent on AI are not justified. There is a rising concern that the costs of building massive data centers and developing new models are too high compared to the actual money these companies are making. Michael Antonelli, a market strategist at Baird, noted that the idea that AI companies can continue to spend unlimited amounts of money is being questioned by the market right now. He added that investors are starting to demand more proof of profitability.
paragraphs.zh: NPR 報導稱，近期的市場下滑部分源於一種日益增長的恐懼，即投入人工智慧的數十億美元資金是否合理。市場越來越擔心，相較於這些公司實際創造的營收，建設大型資料中心與開發新模型的成本過於高昂。貝爾德（Baird）的市場策略師麥可·安東內利（Michael Antonelli）指出，市場目前正在質疑人工智慧公司可以持續無限投入資金的觀點。他補充說，投資人已開始要求看到更多獲利的證明。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the political environment is changing. NPR noted that recent election results have seen candidates win who support slowing down the construction of large data centers. This adds another layer of uncertainty for investors who were previously betting on endless growth for the sector. While some experts believe the overall "bull market" — a period where stock prices are generally rising — that began in 2022 is not over, the current situation shows that the era of easy optimism for AI stocks may be coming to an end.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，政治環境也在改變。NPR 指出，近期的選舉結果顯示，支持放緩大型資料中心建設的候選人贏得了勝利。這為先前押注該產業將無限成長的投資人增添了另一層不確定性。雖然部分專家認為自 2022 年開始的整體「牛市」（即股價普遍上漲的時期）尚未結束，但當前局勢顯示，對人工智慧股票盲目樂觀的時代可能即將告終。

paragraphs.en: As the dust settles, the future of the AI trade remains unclear. Anthropic’s stock price, while lower than its peak, still sits above its original IPO price of $83 per share. However, the company now faces the challenge of proving its value in a market that is much more nervous than it was just a week ago. For now, investors are watching closely to see if the technology sector can recover or if this week marks the beginning of a longer period of difficulty for the industry.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著塵埃落定，人工智慧交易的未來仍不明朗。Anthropic 的股價雖然低於高峰，但仍高於每股 83 美元的原始 IPO 價格。然而，該公司現在面臨著在一個比一週前緊張許多的市場中證明其價值的挑戰。目前，投資人正密切關注科技產業是否能夠復甦，或者本週是否標誌著該產業一段較長困難時期的開始。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A temporary problem or obstacle that slows down progress.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 減速丘（比喻進展中的暫時性障礙或困難）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是馬路上的減速丘，這裡比喻AI產業發展受阻。文中：The excitement surrounding the artificial intelligence industry has hit a major speed bump this week.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To remove or cause to disappear completely.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 抹去、消除（指股市漲幅歸零）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於指擦掉字跡，這裡形容市場漲幅消失。文中：The Nasdaq Composite index, which tracks many tech companies, erased all of its gains for the year 2026.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reduce the amount of something (like money or resources) until it is gone.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於指排水，這裡比喻市場資金被抽走。文中：Chris Beauchamp, an analyst at the trading platform IG, suggested that Anthropic could be "draining market liquidity."

keyTerms.definitionEn: To wait for a situation to become calm or clear after a period of confusion or excitement.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 塵埃落定（指混亂或激動的局面平靜下來）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面是灰塵落下，這裡比喻混亂的市場狀況逐漸明朗。文中：As the dust settles, the future of the AI trade remains unclear.

quiz.question: What happened to the Nasdaq Composite index following the market activity triggered by Anthropic's IPO?

options.A: It reached a record high for the year 2026.
options.B: It lost all the gains it had accumulated throughout the year 2026.
options.C: It fell by exactly 10%, entering correction territory.
options.D: It remained stable while other indexes like the S&P 500 suffered losses.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，Nasdaq Composite 指數在 Anthropic 上市引發的市場動盪中，抹去了 2026 年全年所有的漲幅。選項 A 與事實相反；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章僅提到其他指數進入「修正」區間，並未指明 Nasdaq 指數跌幅剛好為 10%；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到 Nasdaq 指數確實遭受了損失。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might investors be selling their shares in established tech companies like Nvidia or Micron?

options.A: Because these companies announced they were slowing down AI development.
options.B: Because they were forced to sell by government regulations.
options.C: To obtain the necessary capital to purchase shares in the new Anthropic IPO.
options.D: Because they believe these companies are no longer involved in the AI industry.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，分析師 Chris Beauchamp 指出 Anthropic 可能正在「吸乾市場流動性」，意即投資者為了購買 Anthropic 的股票，必須賣掉手中其他科技公司的持股以換取現金。選項 A、B、D 皆無法從文中推論，文中並未提及這些公司停止 AI 開發或受到強制拋售，且這些公司依然是科技業的核心。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'as the dust settles' imply?

options.A: The physical cleaning of the stock exchange floor.
options.B: The process of waiting for a chaotic situation to become calmer and clearer.
options.C: The end of the environmental concerns regarding data centers.
options.D: The literal settling of dirt after a construction project.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。片語「as the dust settles」是一種慣用語，用來比喻在混亂、激烈的事件過後，情況逐漸平靜並變得明朗。文中用此來描述 AI 股票市場在經歷劇烈震盪後，投資者開始觀察未來局勢。選項 A、C、D 皆為字面上的錯誤解讀，與金融市場的語境無關。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the AI industry?

options.A: Anthropic's IPO was a total failure that destroyed the entire global economy.
options.B: Investors are shifting their focus entirely away from AI and toward traditional manufacturing.
options.C: The AI sector is facing a period of skepticism and instability as investors demand proof of profitability.
options.D: The government has officially banned the construction of all new AI data centers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文核心在於討論 Anthropic 上市後引發的市場動盪，以及投資者對 AI 產業過高成本與獲利能力不足的擔憂，這標誌著 AI 產業從「盲目樂觀」轉向「審慎懷疑」。選項 A 太過誇大；選項 B 無法從文中證實；選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到部分候選人支持減緩建設，而非全面禁止。
